_doc: §7 certification-gate CLI version PINS (DISPATCH.md §7 'CLI binaries are standalone — pin + checksum the version you verified'; ADR-0016). These are the CLI versions verified live on this machine (2026-07-16) that the dispatch model-spread migration was validated against. The dispatch CLIs are standalone binaries (NOT npm) whose bundled model registries rot — a version drift can silently change which models are servable. cert-attest.js captures the LIVE CLI behavior per probe (the effective-model artifact is the real drift witness); this file records the verified baseline. ENFORCEMENT DEBT: a live-version-vs-pin drift check is not yet wired (candidate: cert-attest.js records the live `--version` into each artifact + a check compares). Logged so the pin is not merely aspirational.

codex.note: gpt-5.6 family per DISPATCH.md §2; sol attestation via cert-attest.js.

agy.note: invocation: agy --model <id> --print-timeout <bound> -p '<prompt>' (prompt-as-arg, no stdin; `agy models` HANGS — never script it). Model id is the kebab display name, NOT gemini-3.1-pro-preview. The individual-tier `gemini` CLI pin was removed in the 2026-07-20 deep-clean; all Gemini routes through agy.

claude.note: harness session; Claude-5 family (fable-5/sonnet-5) + opus-4-8 per DISPATCH.md §4. opus-5 workhorse cutover (ADR-0016 amendment 2026-07-24): CLI serve VERIFIED live on claude CLI 2.1.219 — `claude -p --output-format json --model claude-opus-5 --effort max` → exit 0, envelope modelUsage.canonicalModel=claude-opus-5 / provider firstParty / contextWindow 1000000 (no 400, no fallback). opus-4-8 stays served. The in-process Agent-tool channel is NOT yet opus-5-servable (α harness-spawn probe still serves opus-4-8) — in-process pins hold at opus-4-8.
